item.title: FULL RESULTS: December 2025 DTLE Dental Technologist board exam passers, topnotchers
item.description: MANILA, Philippines – The Professional Regulation Commission (PRC) releases the full results of December 2025 Dental Technologist licensure exam (DTLE) - Practical and Written on Thursday, December 18, 2025. View here the list of passers, topnotchers, and performance of schools. PRC conducted the licensure exam on December 15, 2025 (Written) and December 16 and 17, 2025 (Practical) in Manila.

item.title: LOTTO RESULT December 17, 2025 6/55, 6/45, 4D, Swertres, EZ2
item.description: MANILA, Philippines – The Philippine Charity Sweepstakes Office (PCSO) announces the official lotto result for Wednesday, December 17, 2025. Monitor here the winning numbers for 6/45, 6/55, EZ2 (2D Lotto), Swertres (3D lotto), and 4D Lotto. PCSO said jackpot prize for the evening major draws – Mega Lotto 6/45 and Grand Lotto 6/55 – now hitting Php 8.9 million and Php 221 million, respectively.
